source_record.description:
Position

You have extensive experience in procuring electronic components and assemblies, a deep market understanding of global electronics supply chains, and expertise in optimizing electronics categories? You are ready for the next step in your career and want to generate measurable added value for our clients in procurement?

Then we have exactly the right role for you:

(SENIOR) EXPERT PROCUREMENT ELECTRONICS
Start anytime, permanent position, often at our clients during the week, and typically on Fridays at our offices in Munich, Cologne, or Hamburg.


Your mission

  • You assess current supply risks and vulnerabilities in critical electronics categories
  • With your understanding of complex supply chains, you create transparency beyond Tier 1 suppliers and identify relevant Tier N dependencies
  • You support the safeguarding of supply continuity by developing and implementing concrete measures, and you contribute your expertise effectively in critical negotiations and supplier situations
  • You identify, evaluate, and introduce alternative sourcing strategies and suitable supplier options
  • You continuously monitor market developments in the semiconductor and electronics environment and derive relevant implications for the supply situation
  • To strengthen supply chain resilience and risk management, you define a clear roadmap and actively share your knowledge and proven best practices with the existing procurement team


Your profile

  • A completed master’s degree from a renowned university, ideally in electrical engineering, industrial engineering, or business administration
  • Several years of experience in electronics procurement or semiconductor sourcing
  • In-depth market knowledge in semiconductors, electronic components, EMS, PCBAs, and control units
  • Proven success in managing shortages
  • Experience with allocation situations and supply disruptions
  • A strong understanding of Tier N transparency and supply chain risk management
  • Experience in industrial manufacturing, the automotive industry, or comparable sectors
  • The ability to combine strategic analysis with implementation-oriented execution
  • Creative problem-solving skills
  • A strong proficiency in German and English rounds off your profile
  • Please apply even if you do not meet all the requirements. You can learn many things on the job with us


What do we offer you?

  • Varied tasks with a high level of responsibility
  • Continuous development opportunities
  • Mentoring program
  • A familiar and friendly working atmosphere
  • Employee events and company retreats twice a year
  • Company car and additional mobility offers
  • Great central offices in Munich, Cologne, and Hamburg
  • Company-wide Friday breakfast meeting
  • Drinks, fruit, and yogurts in the office
  • Employee participation model
  • Company pension plan
  • Company laptop and company phone
  • Sports offerings
